_meta.description: Timestamped captures of the public leaderboard frontier (ranks 1, 50, 100, 250) and the displayed participant count. Each row is a moving snapshot, not a final threshold and not a prize guarantee. The public page exposes only ranks 1-250 while prizes extend through rank 300.
_meta.capture_granularity_note: The 2026-09-17 00:30 capture was read between roughly 00:25 and 00:35 UTC; the 16:56 capture was read between roughly 16:54 and 16:58 UTC; the 19:04 capture between roughly 18:58 and 19:08 UTC; the 20:58 capture between roughly 20:55 and 21:01 UTC; the 21:27 capture between roughly 21:15 and 21:30 UTC. Recorded timestamps are the midpoints of those windows. Leaderboard values update no more than once per hour and rank by realized P/L, which only changes when a participant closes a position (official rules section 08). The 2026-09-18 02:27 capture was read at approximately 02:27 UTC; the timestamp is the read-time marker, not a claim that the page was frozen for an exact second. The 2026-09-19 18:30 capture was read between roughly 18:15 and 18:45 UTC across 16 page chunks (ranks 1-250 fully enumerated); the timestamp is the window midpoint.
observed_notes: Between captures 1 and 2 (~3 hours, US after-hours) rank 1 and rank 250 were byte-identical while the mid-board moved (rank 50 +$28,139.75, rank 100 +$11,027.50).

Between captures 2 and 3 (~16.4 hours, US trading day) ALL FOUR frontiers rose: rank 1 +$31,400.00 (same holder), rank 50 +$75,661.00 (new holder), rank 100 +$28,661.85 (new holder), rank 250 +$31,380.50 (new holder). The 3-hour quiet at captures 1-2 does not generalize: the frontier is a moving target.
Displayed participants rose 93,527 -> 93,702 -> 95,709 (+2,182 total) while registration remained open until 2026-09-23 08:00 UTC.
The value captured at rank 50 on 2026-09-17T00:30:00Z (RIA-JANGHU +$1,172,236.00) had slid to rank 69 by 16:56; the value at rank 100 (msm223034 +$971,231.00) had slid to rank 114.

Between captures 3 and 4 (~2.1 hours, US afternoon session) the board moved in BOTH directions: rank 1 unchanged, rank 50 FELL $3,583.50 (the capture-3 rank-50 row re-appeared verbatim at rank 49, consistent with one removal above rank 50; IR-23/H20), rank 100 rose $12,309.65 (new holder), rank 250 rose $2,235.50 (new holder). A displayed frontier value is therefore not a ratchet floor for that rank.

Displayed participants rose 93,527 -> 93,702 -> 95,709 -> 96,095 while registration remained open until 2026-09-23 08:00 UTC; the landing-page counter read 96,089 at the same minute (IR-09 async counters).
Row-level sliding re-confirmed at capture 4: capture-2 rank 100 msm223034 +$971,231.00 slid to rank 116; capture-3 rank 100 wowlass63 +$999,892.85 slid to rank 103.

Between captures 4 and 5 (~1.9 hours, US after-hours) the movement was rank-heterogeneous: ranks 1 and 50 were byte-identical (leonardo22_romano +$2,335,125.00; Nikola_Ng +$1,244,313.50) while rank 100 rose +$2,747.50 and rank 250 rose +$3,454.50. Capture-4's rank-100 row (JeremyTradezzz +$1,012,202.50) reappeared at rank 101 and capture-3's rank-100 row (wowlass63 +$999,892.85) at rank 105, so the mid-board boundary was pushed down by one new row while the cash-prize edge did not move at all (H22).

Participants displayed rose 93,527 -> 93,702 -> 95,709 -> 96,095 -> 96,236 (+2,709 across the four 2026-09-17 passes) while registration remains open until 2026-09-23 08:00 UTC. The landing page showed 96,230 for the same edition at the same minute (IR-09, asynchronous counters).

Between captures 5 and 6 (~0.48 hours, US evening) ALL FOUR tracked frontiers were byte-identical: rank 1 +$2,335,125.00, rank 50 +$1,244,313.50, rank 100 +$1,014,950.00, rank 250 +$660,759.50, all same holders and same cent values, while participants rose 96,236 -> 96,268 (+32) and the landing page 96,230 -> 96,263 (+33). This is the second observed interval of complete frontier stasis (after the 3-hour freeze at captures 1-2) and, together with H22's heterogeneous rise and H20's correction-driven fall, completes a same-day catalogue of three distinct board behaviours (H24).

Between captures 6 and 7 (~1.68 hours, US evening session) the leaderboard experienced strong threshold acceleration across ranks 50-250: rank 1 was unchanged at +$2,335,125.00 (+934.05%), rank 50 rose +$111,303.63 (+44.52% relative to the prior displayed frontier) to +$1,355,617.13 (+542.25%), rank 100 rose +$76,695.00 (+30.68% relative) to +$1,091,645.00 (+436.66%), and rank 250 rose +$38,065.50 (+15.23% relative) to +$698,825.00 (+279.53%). Participants rose 96,268 -> 96,344 (+76) while the landing hero showed 96,336 (IR-09 async delta +8). This breaks the capture 5->6 plateau and confirms burst velocity dynamics near daily session wrap-ups (H25, IR-25).

Between captures 7 and 8 (~3.3 hours) rank 1 remained unchanged at +$2,335,125.00, while rank 50 rose to +$1,380,404.00, rank 100 to +$1,123,096.25, and rank 250 to +$715,045.00. Displayed participants rose 96,344 -> 96,586 (+242). These are point-in-time board observations, not a forecast or a final prize cutoff.

Between captures 8 and 9 (~40 hours) the FIRST rank-1 turnover since captures began: HappyLittleTrades +$2,485,745.50 (+994.30%) takes the lead (up from rank 3 / +$2,065,935.50 at R9); prior holder leonardo22_romano is byte-identical at +$2,335,125.00 and slides to rank 3. huliusalecsander rises to rank 2 (+$2,396,183.75).

Between captures 8 and 9 the displayed profit of youcanttrickme FELL +$2,324,723.00 (rank 2, R9) -> +$2,270,023.00 (rank 4): realised P/L moves down only when net losers are closed, re-confirming H20 that frontier values are not ratchet floors.

Between captures 8 and 9 the cash-prize edge (rank 50) rose +$1,380,404.00 -> +$1,459,666.50 (+$79,262.50), rank 100 rose +$1,123,096.25 -> +$1,181,405.00, and rank 250 rose +$715,045.00 -> +$757,562.50. Displayed participants rose 96,586 -> 99,663 (+3,077) while registration remains open until 2026-09-23 08:00 UTC; the landing hero read 99,658 at the same session (IR-09 async delta +5).
